quotes.text: The only bad-karma-reducing sposie on the market is a new line of biodegradable (meaning here "useless") sposie that won't last through the lightest of baby pees and will force you to change baby approximately once every thirty seconds, thereby completely undoing any so-called karma reduction. Only bad mommies use sposies.
quotes.reference: 2012, Willow Yamahchi, Bad Mommy, Insomniac Press, →ISBN, page 91:

quotes.text: They will never part even though in mommy's heart she wishes daddy would leave forever. One grief-some January 25 mommy rested never to return for her and daddy went on a walk. “Where is mommy”, said baby but daddy couldn't talk.

senses.definition: (slang, by extension) Any sexually attractive woman.
(BDSM) A dominant female partner, often used as a term of address.
examples: My girlfriend loves it when I call her mommy.

senses.definition: (US, Canada, rare, informal) To treat someone like a mother would; to mother someone.
(US, Canada, rare, informal, chiefly in the superlative) Characteristic of a mother; motherly.
examples: She is the mommiest of mommies.

quotes.text: I am smack-dab in the middle of the mommiest years of my life. There are toys strewn across my once-pristine floors, goldfish crackers in my couch cushions, and empty juice boxes in my car.
